  failed: none
  stopped: none
  outcomes: ok, failed
  inputs: none

vertex red
  procedure: tests-fail
  agent: implementer (harness fake)
  access: workspace-write
  tests: write
  checks: red-check (tests-fail test)
  claims: ok requires red-check, blocked stops
  passed: none
  failed: none
  stopped:
    1. response.reason = misscoped -> misscoped
    2. response.reason = no-test-needed -> no-test
  outcomes: ok, failed, misscoped, no-test, blocked, harness-timeout, harness-transient, harness-unparsed
  inputs:
    findings <- reviewer.review.response.findings (optional)
    previous <- green.green.response | senior-green.green.response (optional)

  tests: frozen

vertex reviewer
  procedure: review
  agent: reviewer (harness fake)
  access: read-only (capped by the Procedure)
  tests: frozen
  checks: review-pass (response), repeat (repeat)
  claims: ok requires none, changes requires none, blocked stops
  passed:
    1. claim = ok and check.review-pass = passed -> ok
    2. check.repeat = failed -> repeat
    3. response.needsTest = true -> retest
  failed: none
  stopped:
    1. response.reason = misscoped -> misscoped
  otherwise: changes
  outcomes: ok, repeat, retest, changes, misscoped, blocked, harness-timeout, harness-transient, harness-unparsed
  inputs:
    report <- green.green.response | senior-green.green.response | implementer-fix.fix.response | senior-dev.fix.response
    red <- red.red-check.evidence | senior-red.red-check.evidence (optional)
    redReport <- red.red.response | senior-red.red.response
    green <- green.test.evidence | senior-green.test.evidence | implementer-fix.test.evidence | senior-dev.test.evidence
